source: DEMO POLICY - configured for demonstration and testing. Diameter range follows the Grade-A figure reported in the press context (45-65 mm) but has NOT been verified against an official government specification document by this project.
notes: These are DEMO thresholds for a working prototype; they are NOT an official procurement standard.

max_surface_damage_pct is null here because the current detector returns BOXES, not masks, so a defect surface-area percentage cannot be measured. A policy must never require a measurement the pipeline cannot produce: see config/grading/strict_with_segmentation.json, which sets the limit and therefore escalates every onion to manual_review with MEASUREMENT_UNAVAILABLE until a segmentation model exists.

The 'relaxed' grade models the real URS (Under Relaxed Specifications) procurement class that has been introduced and withdrawn repeatedly - which is exactly why grading must be policy-driven rather than baked into model weights.

Replace the values and set source_verified=true only after an official specification document is obtained. Enforcement is automatic: src/grading/policy.py REFUSES to load a policy whose source_verified=true lacks source_url + verification_date + an official source_type.
source_type values: official_document | tender | news_context | demo.
